column3: Ukaz `{command}` je zavrnjen: njegovi parametri so preveč globoko gnezdeni.

column3: Ukaz `{command}` je zavrnjen: prek `{key}` bi se prišlo do datoteke v računalniku.

column3: Ukaz `{command}` je zavrnjen: `{key}` je geslo, ki ga vnesete samo vi.

column1: # //// Neoffice — the Nora assistant pane (nora_pane.rs): what it refuses, and its Undo of an old change.

column2: `{command}` is refused: your signature and initials are yours to add.
column3: Ukaz `{command}` je zavrnjen: svoj podpis in svoje začetnice lahko dodate samo vi.

column2: `{command}` is refused: this document's security forbids copying its text.
column3: Ukaz `{command}` je zavrnjen: varnostne nastavitve tega dokumenta prepovedujejo kopiranje njegovega besedila.

column2: Nora's change is too old to be taken back whole: use Undo in the editor instead.

column1: # //// Neoffice — the Nora assistant pane (nora_pane.rs): its Stop button, and its words for a failure of the connection to Nora (craft-libs adbcef6).

column2: Stop
Stopped.
Nora did not answer in time.
Nora could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
column3: Ni bilo mogoče vzpostaviti povezave z Nora. Preverite povezavo in poskusite znova.

column2: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
column3: Vaša seja je potekla. Prijavite se znova.

column2: The server could not answer (error {status}). Try again in a moment.
column3: Strežnik ni mogel odgovoriti (napaka {status}). Poskusite znova čez trenutek.

column2: Nora's answer could not be read.
column3: Nora odgovora ni bilo mogoče prebrati.

column1: # //// Neoffice — the Nora assistant pane (nora_pane.rs): a request a tab in the background kept from acting, and a reply that could not act in time (craft-libs 620d408).

column2: This tab was in the background: Nora could not act in the document.
column3: Ta zavihek je bil v ozadju: Nora ni mogla ukrepati v dokumentu.

column2: Resume
Nothing was done in the document: Nora could not act in it in time. Ask again if you still need it.
column3: V dokumentu ni bilo nič narejeno: Nora ni mogla pravočasno ukrepati. Vprašajte znova, če še potrebujete.

column2: Not all of this was done: part of it could not run in the document in time.
column3: Ni bilo vse narejeno: del tega v dokumentu ni mogel teči pravočasno.
